video_title: Cavs Shootaround | Mario Hezonja & Peyton Watson Media Availability | 10.24.2026

quotes.speaker: Mario Hezonja
quotes.summary_phrase: Mario Hezonja on the differences between European and NBA pregame atmospheres
quotes.excerpt: the announcer always like the way he pronounced like Cavaliers and then they would run out
quotes.quote: I remember my favorite moment was the announcer always like the way he pronounced like Cavaliers and then they would run out because that's not how we do it in Europe. Like you just come out and then that's what it is, like you warm up. So for me like I always remember like that moment. It's like wow, like in the fire like burst out there so that's pretty cool.

quotes.speaker: Mario Hezonja
quotes.summary_phrase: Mario Hezonja on his seamless integration with the Cavaliers organization
quotes.excerpt: it's much easier than I thought thanks to my teammates and the staff
quotes.quote: It's much easier than I thought thanks to my teammates and the staff and pretty much everybody in the whole organization. From the top to the to the last person, really since day one they embraced me with the open arm. They know the basketball player that I am but also get to know the the the person that I am so it's definitely been super great, very welcoming.

quotes.speaker: Mario Hezonja
quotes.summary_phrase: Mario Hezonja on the need to improve ball security and defensive consistency
quotes.excerpt: take care of the ball, how we want to, how we want to attack
quotes.quote: Take care of the ball, how we want to, how we want to attack. I think the defensively we were pretty solid but once Philly started to turn up things we should have definitely be how we were in the first half. Because in NBA you have a 30, 40, 20 point lead, it just doesn't matter anything really because here the game is so fast that in Europe you might struggle to come back from that large lead but here is just like you got to treat it as a 10 point lead.

quotes.speaker: Mario Hezonja
quotes.summary_phrase: Mario Hezonja on adjusting to NBA physicality and defensive reach
quotes.excerpt: those swipes and that physicality and terminology the the the hand is ball
quotes.quote: I said this maybe a week ago, maybe this like those swipes and that physicality and terminology the the the hand is ball. A lot of these reaches you cannot do that in Europe so like you get used to it but then again I prefer much this physical ball. So just getting adjusted to that protecting the ball a little bit more.

quotes.speaker: Mario Hezonja
quotes.summary_phrase: Mario Hezonja on his long-standing relationship and trust with Donovan Mitchell
quotes.excerpt: Donovan is been extraordinary a teammate and extraordinary human being with me
quotes.quote: Donovan is been extraordinary a teammate and extraordinary human being with me first of all. We go way way back. So he was super supportive of that because I see him and I tell him you're not supposed to bring up the ball against the pressure because we need you in the last quarter. We need you in playoffs, we need you in game 80, game 60. Having somebody like me that can help as I said for the first day I'm here to to help you.

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on the team's energy and excitement for the home opener
quotes.excerpt: their energy is going to be contagious, we're going to feed off of them
quotes.quote: It'll be great to play in front of our fans for the first first real regular season game. Their energy is going to be contagious, we're going to feed off of them and we're just looking forward to putting on a great show and putting out a great product for them this season.

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on the team's need to close games stronger
quotes.excerpt: we played at a super high level in the first half of that game and we didn't finish strong
quotes.quote: Just knowing the level that we can reach. Obviously we played at a super high level in the first half of that game and we didn't finish strong and that's something that obviously we need to work on. So it was good to have that test game one of the season, felt like a playoff game.

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on the importance of facing early-season adversity
quotes.excerpt: it's good to face adversity and face challenges, you wouldn't want your first adversity to be in the playoffs
quotes.quote: I think that there's always a sense of urgency and hunger that that team comes in with and I think that we didn't match that. We had to come into that second half with a chip on our shoulder like we need to double this lead instead of temper it. And I think that it was just a good learning experience for us all and we figured out some ways that we can sustain those leads moving forward. It's good to face adversity and face challenges, you wouldn't want your first adversity to be in the playoffs because then you wouldn't know how to handle it or respond to it.

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on the regular season as a developmental tool for the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: the regular season is kind of us practicing our execution for where we want to go down the line
quotes.quote: The regular season is kind of us practicing our execution for where we want to go down the line. So it's good to face adversity and face challenges, you wouldn't want your first adversity to be in the playoffs because then you wouldn't know how to handle it or respond to it. So I think that all these all these games, good or bad, are going to be learning lessons and it's going to make us a more complete team moving forward.

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on maintaining a killer mentality despite large leads
quotes.excerpt: putting your foot on the opposition's neck and making sure that you send a statement to those people
quotes.quote: I think that it's just putting your foot on the opposition's neck and making sure that you send a statement to those people. But like I said that's a super high level team, they weren't going to play two bad halves of basketball and we understood that. But we've got to come out with a higher sense of urgency so that when teams do make runs, we can weather the storm a little bit better.
